## Information Security Requirements

- **Security Considerations:**
  - Identify any specific security requirements related to this issue.
  - If applicable, reference relevant sections from the [OWASP Developer Guide](https://owasp.org/www-project-developer-guide/release/).

- **Potential Security Risks:**
  - Outline any potential security risks or impacts.
  - Describe mitigation strategies or controls to be implemented if security risks require mitigation.

- **Security Tests:**
  - Indicate if security tests are required.
  - Indicate how to test mitigation strategies.
